name: webhook_add_subscription
description: Register a webhook subscription that delivers knowledge-graph change events to an HTTPS endpoint. The delivery worker signs and retries each delivery in the background; this tool only stores the subscription row.

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL that receives delivery POST requests. Must use port 443 (default or explicit), carry no credentials or fragment, and name a host rather than a literal IP address.

eventOperations.description: Change operations to deliver. An empty array (the default) delivers every operation.

entityTypes.description: Entity types to deliver. An empty array (the default) delivers every type.

consumerOrigin.description: Identifies this consumer's own writes, so they are never delivered back to it. Max 231 bytes.

ignoredOrigins.description: More origins whose changes are never delivered. An empty array (the default) ignores none.

secretRef.description: Name of a secret configured on the server, used to sign each delivery. Never the secret value itself.

enabled.description: Whether the subscription is active. Default true.

name: webhook_delete_subscription
description: Delete a webhook subscription by id. Deleting an id that no longer exists is not an error.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription id returned by webhook_add_subscription.
